notes.title: Early Access Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, the time is almost here! Demon Hunt Early Access launches on July 30.

You've been very supportive and patient, so thank you. 

Here is what to expect from Early Access. 


Weapons & Artifacts


I've added 4 new weapons to unlock, each with 3 evolutions as always.

I've removed the Physical and Energy weapon types and introduced 4 new types: Ember, Ion, Void, and Caustic.

These new weapon types can be further enhanced with new artifacts that unlock unique abilities to experiment with.

I've added 33 new artifacts, bringing the total to 60. Some of them unlock new combos based on your weapon’s damage type.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45083386/16ca307d5939e31638eaed9b38e7b50e73aeb889.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45083386/1440dacbd3ed950a187fcd8cfb667a3774e530f6.png"]
Bosses & Threat Levels
There are 3 new final bosses, each with their own threat modifiers and a new enemy type.

As you progress through each boss's threat levels, you'll unlock new rewards.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45083386/5884b64371f90fa1619321c01496e79ccc0475b0.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45083386/9a8db4858f513c569a8ca57459b6b6d9135bf0c3.png"]
Items
I've reworked the Unique and Set Item abilities. Now there are 42 Unique Items and 12 Set Items.

Unique Items modify a specific evolution of a specific weapon. So every weapon evolution gets some new abilities through these Unique Items.

Set Items grant powers tailored to the End Boss you're hunting, each boss has a set that counters their abilities.

I also reorganized the Workbench screen to make it clearer and more flexible.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45083386/deb79769487d324edbcd494f67d86a3d639ac563.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45083386/5d1c5adcbc3129e6cde092c410bfed4b78d1e04f.png"]
Mechas & Talent Trees
2 new mechas have been added, each with a modified sprint ability and its own talent tree.

These mechas also feature new health mechanics, like Barrier and Shield, to give you an edge.

I've redesigned the Talent Tree screen with updated visuals and reworked the mecha models.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45083386/7b57abaf8522a5c9d0cd6fb2bb0a635cb3a9fa94.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45083386/d89c3ca3e5c9e4d76bcba9998adaaff75bc310e9.png"]


Orbs
7 new orbs have been added, bringing the total to 20.

And you can unlock all of the Orb Slots, which is 16 in total.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45083386/62c64f8c7a1fee19a9a86d9e55287435b52ee29d.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45083386/3cb456b73e3f95ec5a229ca8b1bf3d3f19ffbb76.png"]

I've upgraded design of Base, enemy shaders and added bunch of sound effects, visual effects, QoL and much more!

Check the new trailer on the store page if you didn't!



And also sorry for delaying the release of the game from Q2 and for the late announcement. I just needed a bit more time and wanted to be certain about what would be included in the release before making it official. I also removed the demo from the store page, as it had become quite outdated and I didn’t want it to mislead newcomers. Additionally, progress from the demo will be reset in the Early Access release.



I hope you like these new changes! Can't wait to share them with you finally.

Much love.

notes.title: 0.17.002 & Steam Next Fest Demo Release and 10k Wishlists!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Great news, Demon Hunt hit 10k wishlists just before the Steam Next Fest! This was an important milestone for me, so thank you all! 

This also concludes the open playtest, you can still play it if you are in the playtest of course. So this is most likely the last update before Early Access. 
Because a Demo is live for the Steam Next Fest, its basically the same with the playtest version and shares the same save file. 

Here are the updates : 

-Added OST. They are not in their final form as I made them in really short time. 
-Changed the experience pick up sound. But you can select the old version in the settings if you like it more.
-Updated the mecha model.
-Ultrawide monitors should work fine now on main menu too.
-There is a crash happening at Appu(Boss 4). This patch should fix it, so please let me know if it happens again.
-Added weapon evolutions descriptions. 
-Updated the store & library images


-Balance changes 
-Artifact Force Shield cooldown { 10, 9, 8, 7, 6 } => { 20, 18, 16, 14, 12 }
-Artifact Target Matrix damage  {%8, %10, %12, %16, %20 } => {%2, %4, %6, %8, %10}
-Artifact Energy Absorber {%30, %40, %50, %60, %70 } => {%20, %25, %30, %35, %40}
-Artifact Don't Stop 
Damage Bonus {%20, %22, %24, %26, %30 } => {%10, %12, %14, %16, %2}
Penalty {%2, %2.2, %2.4, %2.6, %3.0 } => {%3, %3.2, %3.4, %3.6, %4}
Also shortened the activation time from 0.3 seconds to 0.1 seconds. But added a late activation time when you unpause the game.
-Removed the Artifact Expander for now.
-Dualsaber base damage 26 => 28
-Field ring damage 4 => 2
-Kunai base damage 22 => 20
-Kunai base pierce power 0.8 => 0.7
-Minigun base damage 10 => 12
-Swarm cloud base damage 14 => 16
-Swarm cloud rarity damage rate { 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2 } => { 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 }

Thank you all for your feedback and opinions—they’ve been incredibly helpful!

notes.title: 0.17.001 Patch Notes & Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This took a bit more then I expected, some changes and some new stuff. Let me know what you think!

-Wave time reduced from 30 to 20 seconds.
 I think the game was feeling a bit too long and dragging out at times, so this change should make it more fast paced.
 Basically 30 seconds worth of enemy spawns in 20 seconds now, so I increased all of the weapons dps to compensate.
 This change shortens the total run by 8 minutes approximately.
 
-New item system.
 You can recycle your items for reagents and craft new items or upgrade your existing ones now.
 Added set items and unique items.
 They don't drop from enemies directly, but instead enemies drop unique/set tokens which you can use to craft unique/set items in your base. 
 I made it so you can choose which item you get since they have a low drop rate. 
 Added storage space for items in base.
 This whole system is a bit barebone and I will add more features and balance it in future patches.

-New item theme.
 I changed the theme of items to mecha parts instead of clothing.
 Made 78 new item icons, although I'll continue working on them to add more color and variety, I think they fit better with the game's look.

-Chest
 New point of interest on the map that drops items.

-Ultrawide monitor support
 This feature asked by many people so here it is, but I didn't get the chance to test it on a ultrawide screen. 
 So if there is a problem you see please let me know.

-Added ne stats. Leech Chance, Leech Power and Luck.
-Lowered the overall bloom effect, and turned downed the emission of some materials to make it a bit more easy on the eyes.

-Balances
 Elite mobs have more health and speed now. 
 Increased range mobs projectile speed.
 Reduced Mortar Ion Ring's flame count rarity upgrades.  { 0, 2, 4, 8, 16 } => { 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 }
 Reduced Dualsaber radius upgrades. { 0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 } => { 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 }


-Roadmap
 After this patch I will be working on fixing, balancing and polishing until February Steam Nextfest.
 Which I will be participating with this alpha version of the game as a demo. 
 After the Nextfest I will be focusing on getting the game ready for the Early Access.
 My goal is to get it ready until the Summer. We can say late Q2 2025. (April-May)
 I'm planning to add more bosses, weapons, mechas, artifacts and maybe some new mechanics regarding weapon combos.
 And I want to upgrade or change some of the assets to achieve a more cohesive game look, its a bit all over the place right now.
 Between Nextfest and Early Access period I don't think there will be much update to the Demo. 
 But I want to playtest the game just before launching Early Access so there will be a couple of weeks for you the test it before hand.
 There are so many things planned for 2025! 
 I really hope it will go well and the game will be in a good shape.
 Thank you all for your feedback and support, also very curious to hear your thoughts on this upgrade.
 Happy weekends everyone!

notes.title: alpha 0.15.007 patch notes
notes.notes:
Hello! First part of meta progression is here;

-Orbs : Place orbs into slots to gain permanent power ups. 
Slots comes in different sizes and colors, each placed orb grants power up depending on its slots qualities.

-Armory : You can see weapons and artifacts here. Complete quests to unlock weapons as a starting weapon.


 Fixes and balances;

-Controller should work better in upgrade screen now.
-Fixed a bug in rarity upgrade screen that could enable players to spam upgrade button with controller.
-Decreased enemy count in waves before bosses.
-Increased moth enemy's speed.
-Moths start shooting projectiles sooner but their shooting interval is longer 
-Nerfed move speed artifact.
-Buffed pick up radius artifact.
-Decreased shrine duration slightly.
-Increased well count spawned on map.
-Balanced audio volume settings values.
-Bigger item indications on mini map.
-Increased Don't Stop artifacts activation delay time.
-Bosses damage text placement improvements.

notes.title: alpha 0.15.006 patch notes
notes.notes:
alpha 0.15.006 patch notes

Hello everyone! New batch of fixes and improvements

-Fixed the crash happening when upgrading Ion Mortar's 3rd evolution.
-Artifacts' rarity upgrade descriptions are available now.
-Minigun pierce rarity shows properly now.
-Manual aim laser is visible when there is a manual aim weapon, hidden if there is none.
-Improvements to the save system. Trying not to force players reset progress with updates.
-There was a glitch causing some variables persist through runs after restarting. This was causing to start the run with zero health and last player position. I tried to fix this with a temporary solution in the previous patch which caused a bug that doesn't let players to be able to die. This glitch should be fixed now in this patch properly.
-Fixed a bug that might have be causing some artifacts to be hidden.
-Damage text position improvements.
